mapper.select: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ast41_start_date) AS invest_limit_id , ast41_start_date AS start_date FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY ast41_start_date ORDER BY ast41_start_date DESC

SELECT ast41_invest_limit_id AS invest_limit_id , ast41_start_date AS start_date , ast41_invest_asset_type AS invest_asset_type , f_cdnm('InvestAssetType', ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_company_id, ast41_start_date) AS invest_asset_name , ast41_limit_rate AS limit_rate , ast41_stop_loss_rate AS stop_loss_rate , ast41_note AS note FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date = #{startDate}

SELECT ast41_invest_limit_id AS invest_limit_id , ast41_start_date AS start_date , ast41_invest_asset_type AS invest_asset_type , f_cdnm('InvestAssetType', ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_company_id, ast41_start_date) AS invest_asset_name , ast41_limit_rate AS limit_rate , ast41_stop_loss_rate AS stop_loss_rate , ast41_note AS note FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_invest_limit_id = #{investLimitId} AND ast41_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT ast41_invest_limit_id AS invest_limit_id , ast41_start_date AS start_date , ast41_invest_asset_type AS invest_asset_type , NULL AS invest_asset_name , ast41_limit_rate AS limit_rate , ast41_stop_loss_rate AS stop_loss_rate , ast41_note AS note FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_start_date = ( SELECT max(ast41_start_date) FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date <= current_date) AND ast41_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast41_invest_limit (ast41_invest_limit_id, ast41_company_id, ast41_start_date, ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_limit_rate, ast41_stop_loss_rate, ast41_note) VALUES (#{investLimitId}, #{companyId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.investAssetType}, #{req.limitRate}, #{req.stopLossRate}, #{req.note})
